title: Log entry
description: One entry of the append-only project log (ADR-014): a single file per entry, named by its own sortable ULID, so concurrent offline creation never collides and directory order is chronological order. The entry does not redeclare timestamp or actor: the common envelope already carries them — createdAt is when the event happened and createdBy is who caused it — and restating them here would only open a door for the two records to disagree. That the log is append-only, so an entry is never edited after it lands, is a rule the store enforces; no field of this schema could express it.

allOf.title: An authorization event records what was asked, of which agent, and who decided
An agent run event names the agent that ran

summary.description: The entry's human-readable line, the one that renders in a plain log view without opening payload.

eventType.description: A closed catalog of what a log entry can record. Widening it is a schema change, not a free-form edit: the log is the audit trail agents and humans both rely on, so a new kind of event needs a decision, not a typo.

payload.description: The typed detail an eventType carries. Which properties are required depends on eventType, enforced by the allOf above; the shape here only bounds what each property may be.

agentRef.description: The agent definition the run or the authorization concerns.

capability.description: Which of the seven permission categories the authorization was about. It is the same closed catalog agents.json declares levels for, referenced rather than restated.

grantedBy.description: Who decided the authorization. Narrowed to a human: an agent cannot authorize itself or another agent.
